title: Add customer ratings to completed bookings
description: Implement customer-submitted reviews/ratings for boat operators after booking completion. Ratings displayed on operator profile and search results.
spec:
1. Prisma schema: add Review model (customerId, operatorId, rating 1-5, comment text, createdAt)
2. API: POST /api/reviews with auth check + validation
3. UI: app/(customer)/reviews/new/page.tsx with form
4. Display: Show average rating on operator cards in search
5. Admin: List reviews with moderation options
constraints: No duplicate review per customer per operator
Display uses Tailwind only, shadcn/Radix UI for modal
Email notification to operator on new review
acceptance_criteria: Form validates rating (1-5) and comment (5-500 chars)
Review saved to DB with timestamp
Average rating displayed on operator cards
Admin can see all reviews with customer name + timestamp
pnpm test:e2e includes new customer review flow
notes: Similar to existing Booking + Ticket pattern. See lib/email.ts for notification template. Port email to lib/email.ts, don't hardcode.
